_about: Generic right-handed address poses used as the alignment ghost when a pro has no extracted keypoints. COCO-17 order, torso units (mid-shoulder to mid-hip = 1), origin = mid-hip, y down. fo: golfer faces camera, target to the right of frame. dtl: camera behind the hands, golfer faces right. Forward bend set to 41.5 deg (elite mean, JSSM 2018).
